confidence_notes: Food anchors are based on aggregated cost-of-living estimates from a web search: cappuccino about INR 100-190, local beer about INR 140-210 retail or at a neighbourhood pub, budget meal about INR 190-280, and mid-range dinner for two about INR 1,200-1,800. The sources disagree somewhat. Beer, coffee and meals were adjusted upward for restaurant serving and for Udaipur's touristy lakeside areas. Draft beer is uncommon, so beer is based on a bottled or pint serving. I did not search for cocktail and wine prices. They are estimated from how they usually compare with beer in India, where wine is heavily taxed and venues that serve it are mostly upmarket, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates only. Udaipur has many budget hostels and guesthouses, while prices for 3-star heritage hotels vary widely by season. July is the monsoon low season, which may push prices down.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Jaipur and other Rajasthan tourist cities. Udaipur has similar Indian price levels, with a premium for tourist and lake-view areas.
